Loom: the SRAM macro block below and the four FP_PDN_V* stripe keys are the only changes to
the template (docs/DECISIONS.md D-020, D-021). They are the recipe that took the macro
through hardening, precheck and gl_test on branch sram-smoke (docs/tt_cmos5l_facts.md
section 11), adapted from the 2x2 smoke test to this 6x4 block.
Here are some of the variables you may want to change:
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
Users have reported that values up to 80 worked well for them.
CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds, so 20ns == 50MHz.
Hold slack margin - Increase them in case you are getting hold violations.
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!
If you need a custom clock configuration, read the following documentation first:
https://tinytapeout.com/faq/#how-can-i-map-an-additional-external-clock-to-one-of-the-gpios
MACROS - the LibreLane way of bringing in a hard macro (NOT EXTRA_LEFS/EXTRA_GDS_FILES).
https://librelane.readthedocs.io/en/latest/usage/using_macros.html . Key = the macro name.
Everything below is vendored at IHP-Open-PDK commit 2bbec755; see
macro/RM_IHPSG13_1P_512x16_c2_bm_bist/README.md.
instances - the key is the instance's FLATTENED path (CheckMacroInstances rejects anything
else; sram-smoke CI run 1). tt_um_loom.u_loom (loom_top) -> u_imem (loom_imem) ->
generate block g_macro (IMEM_IMPL MACRO) -> u_macro (loom_imem_macro) -> sram. Yosys,
reading the sources the way LibreLane does and flattening, names the cell
u_loom.u_imem.g_macro.u_macro.sram. PDN_MACRO_CONNECTIONS below uses the same path.
orientation FS - mirrored about the X axis (LEF SYMMETRY X Y R90 allows it). All 108 signal
pins of the macro are Metal2 stubs at LEF y 0..0.26, its bottom edge; FS puts them on
its TOP edge, facing the free rows above it where the logic sits. Mirroring about X
keeps every power column at the same x, so the stripe alignment below is unchanged.
Orientation must keep the columns vertical (N, FS, FN or S): the stripes are Metal4
like the pins, so they cannot cross them. Unmirrored (N) with the pins 6 um from the
core edge, sram-smoke CI run 4 drowned in detailed routing.
location [12, 40] - lower-left corner of the placed macro, absolute die coordinates.
6x4 block (tt-support-tools, branch ihp-sg13cmos5l, tech/ihp-sg13cmos5l/def/
tt_block_6x4_pgvdd.def): DIEAREA 0 0 1289.28 710.64; ROW_0 at (2.88, 3.78), 186 rows of
LEFT_MARGIN_MULT 6 x 0.48 = 2.88 and BOTTOM_MARGIN_MULT 1 x 3.78, the same core origin
as the 2x2 smoke test, so (12, 40) is the smoke test's placement relative to the core
and every number checked there carries over. All 43 block pins are on the top edge
with its signal pins at y 231.08..231.34. Above it: the 10 um halo, then 123 rows
(y 241.92..706.86) for the logic and the 63 tie cells of the tied-off macro pins.
Right of it: x 258.80..1286.40 at full height. Below it: 6 rows (y 3.78..26.46).
x: the stripe grid below has its POWER stripe centres at 2.88 + 26.36 + 67.44 n =
29.24 + 67.44 n. Four cross the macro, at 29.24, 96.68, 164.12 and 231.56, which is
macro-local 17.24, 84.68, 152.12 and 219.56, inside VDD!/VDDARRAY! columns; the
GROUND stripes 5.62 um to the right (local 22.86, 90.30, 157.74, 225.18) are inside
VSS! columns. The same holds at x = 12 + 67.44 k for any k (the macro moves by whole
stripe pitches); any other x needs FP_PDN_VOFFSET recomputed (src/pdn_cfg.tcl).
y: FS puts VDD! (local y 0..38.825, pin edge) at die y 192.52..231.34 and VDDARRAY!
(local 45.465..191.34) at die y 40..185.88. The stripes run through the macro over
the full core height (y 3.56..707.08), so each of the four POWER stripes lies in a
VDD! column and a VDDARRAY! column and both supplies are reached at any y; y = 40 is
the smoke test's value (routed clean: 94 violations at iteration 0, none from
iteration 3), with the pin edge 475 um below the core top.
lib - keyed by timing-corner wildcard. The cmos5l STA corners are nom_typ_1p20V_25C,
nom_fast_1p32V_m40C and nom_slow_1p08V_125C, and LibreLane loads every key that
matches (common/toolbox.py filter_views). The reference project's keys (nom_*, min_*,
max_*, *) gave the typ lib at all three corners (sram-smoke CI runs 5 and 7), so the
keys name the process corner.
nl - the port-only blackbox in src/, not the behavioural model. Same as the reference.
PDN_MACRO_CONNECTIONS - hooks the macro's power pins onto the block's nets without needing
USE_POWER_PINS in the RTL. Format: <instance> <block power net> <block ground net>
<macro power pin> <macro ground pin>. The macro has three: VDD! (periphery), VDDARRAY!
(the bit-cell array) and VSS!. Both supplies go to VPWR, as the reference project does;
the macro would allow them to be separate rails but Tiny Tapeout only gives us one.
PDN_CFG - LibreLane's default PDN script with its macro grid replaced. On cmos5l
FP_PDN_VERTICAL_LAYER is Metal4, which is also the layer of the macro's power pins, and
TopMetal1 belongs to tt_top, so the default macro grid (Metal4 <-> TopMetal1) is empty
(PDN-0232, sram-smoke CI runs 2-3) and pdngen alone leaves the macro unconnected (run 4).
The script lets the stripes run through the macro inside its same-net Metal4 power
columns, so every stripe is one full-height power pin (the precheck pin check demands that;
run 5's cut stripes failed it), verifies every stripe over the macro, and fails the PDN
step at once if check_power_grid still finds an open.
SRAM GDS has no PR boundary layer; read the full GDS instead of a blackbox.
(cmos5l sets PRIMARY_GDSII_STREAMOUT_TOOL=klayout, so this may end up unused; kept because
it is harmless and it is what the reference needs.)
SRAM macro internals trigger massive DRC in Magic (57,923 in the smoke test, every one
inside the macro: Magic's cmos5l tech lacks the SRAM exceptions of the KLayout deck); Magic
DRC is not part of the cmos5l precheck, whose KLayout SG13CMOS5L deck checks the merged
GDS (0 violations in the smoke test). KLayout DRC is already off below.
ERROR_ON_ILLEGAL_OVERLAPS - off for ONE known, checked case. The four POWER stripes cross
the macro's VDD!/VDDARRAY! split, where the LEF puts a Metal4 OBS across each power column
(local y 39.085..45.205, die y 186.135..192.255 here). Magic extracts the macro from its
LEF (MAGIC_EXT_ABSTRACT_CELLS below) and reports each crossing as 'Illegal overlap between
obsm4 and metal4 (types do not connect)': 5 boxes in sram-smoke CI run 7, all at the POWER
stripes' x. The macro GDS, flattened, has no Metal4 (any datatype), Via3 or TopMetal1
within 1 um of those stripes in that band, LVS passes, and the precheck's KLayout DRC checks
the real metal. The count is still reported as magic__illegal_overlap__count in the run's
metrics; anything beyond those crossings would be a new problem.
Blackbox the SRAM macro during SPICE extraction for LVS: the IHP macros are not LVS clean.
DRT_OPT_ITERS stays at LibreLane's default (64): the smoke test's cap of 12 bounded a tiny
design's failed runs and is not meant for this block.
Configuration docs: https://librelane.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/configuration.html

Absolute die size
PDN geometry (D-021). VPITCH, VSPACING and VOFFSET differ from the template, and only so
that the Metal4 stripes sit inside the macro's Metal4 power pins. VWIDTH stays at the
template's 2.1 because these stripes are also the block's power pins, which tt_top connects
to (2.1 is the precheck's minimum power-port width on cmos5l).
VPITCH   67.44 = 6 x 11.24 um, the macro's same-net power column pitch, chosen so that no
stripe lands in the macro's irregular middle band (template: 50). Over this
core that is 19 stripe pairs, at 29.24 + 67.44 n (n = 0..18).
VSPACING 3.52: OpenROAD puts the GROUND stripe of a pair at (spacing + width) = 5.62 um
from the POWER stripe centre, which is the macro's POWER-to-GROUND column
distance.
VOFFSET  26.36 measured from the core-area xMin of 2.88 (the same on 2x2 and 6x4), giving
the first POWER stripe centre at 29.24 = macro x 12 + 17.24.
Full derivation and the verified stripe positions are in src/pdn_cfg.tcl.
